text_block_list.text:
Before we know it, it's time for the
Japanese
Derby. Фудзи Кисэки is courteous
to the reporters
crowding her for quotes
and entertains them with
humor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The audience's expectations for her are
high, and
the younger student watches
with mixed feelings.
Fuji Kiseki carries all
their emotions upon her
shoulders as she
enters the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
